The Observatory, A Viceroy Resort—Sun Valley, Idaho
The Observatory, A Viceroy Resort—Sun Valley, Idaho

Where it’s located: In downtown Ketchum, a few minutes away from skiing at Sun Valley Resort. It’s inside the Central Idaho Dark Sky Reserve, the nation’s first Gold Tier International Dark Sky Reserve, spanning more than 1,400 square miles of protected night skies.

Why we’re excited: While other Rocky Mountain towns have become more about the scene than the skiing, Sun Valley has quietly charted its own course, which is exactly why it’s feeling so special this season. The resort has long been a hideaway for billionaires and Hollywood types, but its hospitality scene has lacked a real luxury option until now. The Observatory is one of Viceroy’s first openings since announcing its comprehensive brand launch two years ago, and it has all the polish you would expect: 73 slick guest rooms, 12 lavish penthouses, a full-service spa, restaurant, café and bar. But it’s the rooftop observatory that will be the property’s defining feature and clearest embodiment of Viceroy’s new experience-driven ethos—with programming led by local astronomer and celestial photographer Travis Amick, including stargazing, private sessions and experiences timed to astronomical events such as meteor shower sand planetary alignments. The Observatory will be great for skiing, yes, but it will be great for much more, too.

Matt Kisiday

There was a time when fall was hospitality’s quiet season—the quiet lull between summer beach trips and ski season escapades, the time when back to school and back to work meant people largely stayed home. Not anymore. The trend that advisors and insiders seem to be talking about these days is how shoulder season is the new peak season. And this season, some of travel’s most exciting debuts are landing in this exact window: an English country-style inn from the beloved SingleThread team in Healdsburg, California; new boutique options in New Orleans and Savannah, two of the South’s most popular destinations this time of year; and an effortless Yucatán long weekend escape, too. If an autumn getaway is in your future, these are the most exciting hotel openings to have top of mind.

The Selvedge, A SingleThread Inn

The Selvedge, A SingleThread Inn—Healdsburg, California

During harvest season when Healdsburg’s best reservations are that much trickier to secure, that perk alone is worth its weight in gold.
